The '''south landing bay''' was a part of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]], [[Skytop Station/Legends|Skytop Station]]. It was there that the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']] landed to [[Raid on Skytop Station/Legends|extract]] a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] strike team and where [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]], [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Denal/Legends|Denal]] and a [[Unidentified clone trooper pilot (Twilight)/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] stood their ground against a squad of [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|Super Battle Droids]] and three [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]].
